subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should OpenClaw support `~/.volta/bin/node` as a managed macOS LaunchAgent fallback when the current execPath is `~/.volta/tools/image/node/<version>/bin/node` and no supported system/Homebrew Node is available?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but accepting it changes managed-service runtime policy from warning against version-manager paths toward supporting a specific Volta shim fallback, and this needs maintainer intent plus live launchd proof.

options.title: Review a proof-backed Volta fallback
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the candidate or a replacement PR to prove a real macOS LaunchAgent install/reinstall under Volta before accepting the policy change.

options.title: Reject Volta service shim fallback
options.body: Keep the current system/Homebrew Node policy, document that Volta-managed service runtimes remain warned or unsupported, and then close this issue after the maintainer decision.

options.title: Adopt the narrow helper change now
options.body: Accept the resolver/test change without live proof and own the risk that Volta shims behave differently under launchd than in an interactive shell.

recommendation.title: Review a proof-backed Volta fallback
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the candidate or a replacement PR to prove a real macOS LaunchAgent install/reinstall under Volta before accepting the policy change.

likelyOwner.reason: The system-Node preference and Homebrew resolver precedent both route through steipete's runtime-selection and merge history.
